embeds.title: 📊 WoW Market Briefing · Nov 28
embeds.description:
**Verdict**
• **Best play: Journeyman sealed writs at 22s** (111 listed). An opened writ averages about 1g 31s net, and only 7% are worth less than 22s.
• **Best crafts:** Smelt Heavy Thorium (~4g 90s a bar, ~107 sell a day), Devilsaur Gauntlets (~25g), Smelt Dark Iron (~3g 20s).
• **Floor reset:** Gift of Arthas was dumped to 46s. It sold at 2g 35s-2g 50s until Nov 26 and costs ~2g 76s to craft.
• **Sell, don't hold:** Heavy Thorium Bar has fallen from 11g to 5g 51s in four days, and Arcanite Bar is still sliding.
• The market as a whole is steady: the price index stayed within ±3% all week.
